_meta.purpose: Pool of attested personal names for unnamed NPCs (brief §9.1: never invent names; match to origin).

source.what: CDLI bulk ATF dump, Hallock PF texts (OIP 92) with CDLI English translations
source.file: https://github.com/cdli-gh/data (cdliatf_unblocked.atf, LFS sha256 2896ec25…d836, fetched via media.githubusercontent.com); catalogue cdli_cat.csv
source.coverage: 67 Persepolis Fortification texts only (PF 1–60, 400–406 = OIP 092 0001–0060, 0400–0406). No PT (Cameron, OIP 65) text is in the dump.
source.licence: CDLI terms of use (cdli.earth/terms-of-use, seen as a search extract only): data "may be freely copied, aggregated and re-used according to common and fair academic practice"; re-use of considerable data must cite CDLI. The cdli-gh/data repo has no LICENSE file. Transliterations/translations derive from Hallock, PF (OIP 92, 1969), which ISAC distributes as a free PDF. Cite: CDLI + Hallock PF no.

source.what: Hinz & Koch, Elamisches Wörterbuch (1987), personal-name lemmas as digitised in the DANES-ALP "MEGA" lemma base (E. J. Smith files)
source.coverage: Achaemenid Elamite (achE) lemmas written with HAL (hh.) or MUNUS (f.) determinative. EWB draws on PF, PF-NN (Hallock unpublished), PT and inscriptions; the lemma base does not say which text.
source.licence: No licence stated in the repository. Names are used as bare facts (form, sex, etymon) with EWB page citation; do not redistribute the CSV. Flag for review before public release.

_meta.method: CDLI: every {hal}/{munus} token in the 67 PF texts was curated by hand against the CDLI/Hallock translation line; genitive -na after kurmin ("supplied by") removed; titles and role nouns written with {hal} (kurtaš, sunki/EŠŠANA, mardam, kantira-ikkimar, akkayašeikki, {munus}abbamuš) excluded. Name = Hallock translation form (diacritics except š dropped). EWB: achE lemmas with hh./f. determinative; male names kept only if the lemma base frequency field ≥ 2 and the reading is undamaged; all female lemmas kept (damaged ones flagged reading_uncertain) except the title abbamuš; spelling variants with the same EWB etymon merged; lemmas already matched to a CDLI name merged into that record. EWB names normalised mechanically: determinative dropped, accents/indices stripped, q→k, CV-VC → CVC.

fields.count: CDLI: number of distinct PF texts in the dump with the name (null for EWB-only names).
fields.ewb_freq: frequency column of the EWB lemma base (meaning undocumented; plausibly number of references cited). Used only for ranking; it is NOT a verified attestation count.
fields.archive: "PF" = attested in a CDLI PF text; "achE (PF/PT not distinguished)" = EWB lemma, archive unknown.
fields.notable: name of a royal or top official; avoid for generic NPCs unless it is meant to be that person.
fields.role_in_text: what the person does in the cited PF texts (from the translation).

tiers.A: name form read in a primary text (CDLI transliteration of Hallock PF).
tiers.B: name form from a standard secondary lexicon (EWB) — primary text not seen this session.
tiers.C: origin_guess: from etymology or onomastic element, not from an ethnic label in the text (only Badušduš has a gentilic label). EWB (Hinz) etymologies are often over-Iranianising; treat as C.

_meta.origin_values: Iranian | Elamite | Babylonian | West Semitic | Egyptian | Greek | Anatolian | Indian | unknown ("West Semitic" added for Aramaic-type names).
